items.headline: Marni and HOKA make a designer running shoe
items.caption: The second collab turns HOKA's Clifton 11 into a Marni shoe.
body: Big, cushioned shoes that look fun and save your joints.
It launches on 12 November.
How to wear it: with cropped wide trousers.

items.headline: Phileo and KEEN make tough shoes for art workers
items.caption: A boot, a clog and a hairy suede shoe for people who build art.
body: Designer Philéo Landowski's label is backed by Comme des Garçons fans.
The FW26 line includes the Evanston boot and Providence clog.
How to wear it: with workwear and thick socks.

items.headline: Salomon and The Broken Arm make a fun winter boot
items.caption: The Grolle has scuffed leather and colourful stitching.
body: It already looks worn-in, like years-old boots.
Metal details make it less boring than most.
How to wear it: with straight jeans, cuffed.

items.headline: Arc'teryx's two-in-one winter boot
items.caption: The Postour pairs a chunky boot with a removable slipper.
body: It looks like a Moon Boot or UGG, with a big Arc'teryx logo.
Highsnobiety calls it a hidden bargain.
How to wear it: with joggers and a puffer.

items.headline: Beams x Salomon make a snow boot that looks like a sneaker
items.caption: The XT-Quest GTX marks Beams' 50th birthday.
body: It's the first Beams x Salomon collab sold outside Japan.
It's built for proper bad weather.
How to wear it: with a fleece and cargo trousers.

items.headline: The sneakers that walked around the world
items.caption: Karl Bushby walked home to Hull for 28 years in Merrell Moabs.
body: He covered about 31,000 miles through 30 countries.
He wore his Moabs out and kept buying more.
Style lesson: buy shoes for how you live.

items.headline: Pierpaolo Piccioli is leaving Balenciaga
items.caption: The designer exits just over a year after he started.
body: Balenciaga thanked him for bringing back its couture roots.
Rumours of his exit began in September.
Watch who comes next: it will shape 2027 style.

items.headline: Meermin's anniversary loafer, now in shell cordovan
items.caption: A burgundy penny loafer built to last decades.
body: Shell cordovan is a rare, tough leather menswear fans love.
It marks Meermin's 25th anniversary.
How to wear it: with grey flannels or jeans.

items.headline: Bob Dylan's Vatican look: hoodie, gloves, polka-dot tie
items.caption: The 85-year-old met the Pope in a black hoodie and long coat.
body: The hoodie was by French label Fursac.
He also carried an umbrella with a red handle.
Style lesson: all black, one fun detail.

items.headline: Hublot relaunches its very first watch
items.caption: The Classic Fusion Tributo honours founder Carlo Crocco's original.
body: Esquire met Crocco in Milan for the launch.
His rubber-strap idea changed modern watch design.
Style lesson: a rubber strap can be dressy.

items.headline: Zidane is selling his first luxury watch
items.caption: A Cartier Pasha bought with his first footballer's salary.
body: It goes on sale at Christie's Geneva on 9 November.
It could fetch up to about £18,000.
Style lesson: a steel chronograph never ages.

items.headline: Louis Vuitton's mirror-steel Tambour Convergence
items.caption: A shiny, harder steel version of LV's 37mm guichet watch.
body: A patented treatment makes the steel nearly six times harder.
It's cheaper than the gold and platinum versions.
How to wear it: alone, no other jewellery.

items.headline: Seabirds return after bird flu wiped them out
items.caption: Sandwich terns went from 0 to 756 on England's south coast.
body: RSPB conservation work helped them come back three years after avian flu.
Little terns, ringed plovers and oystercatchers also grew in number.

items.headline: A fireball meteor shower lights up next week
items.caption: The Northern Taurids are best seen on Monday, 9 November.
body: A new moon means darker skies for spotting them.
Expect about 8-12 shooting stars an hour.

items.headline: Italy's murder rate falls to among the EU's lowest
items.caption: A big turnaround from the mafia violence of the 1980s and 90s.
body: Italy had 0.57 homicides per 100,000 people in 2023.
The European average was 0.91.
